title: Scendi Score: Prompt-Aware Diversity Evaluation via Schur Complement of CLIP Embeddings
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a new diversity metric (Scendi Score) for generative models. While it discusses bias in the context of demographic representation (e.g., age and gender distribution in generated images), it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religious beliefs, faith traditions, or ethical frameworks.
